Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-110.json runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli start --case ../data/cases/dev/case-110.json --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --slot 4 --why "Only the 1.52d vs 2.93d pair carries real support; slot 4 gives max 4-sigma separation between them"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --slot 10 --why "Support at 0.954 is short of theta; slot 10 gives 4-sigma separation against the next-strongest residual candidate 3"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli state --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

content.text: Slot 25 available, 4σ separation for the now-live pair. Observe there.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --slot 25 --why "Prior two points overturned candidate 0; slot 25 gives 4-sigma separation for the now-leading 1.06d vs 18.6d pair"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

content.text: Still resolvable — 4σ separation available at slot 29. Two observations left; use one now, reserve one for confirmation.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --slot 29 --why "3 vs 4 flipped lead and remains close; slot 29 is the earliest 4-sigma separator with budget left to confirm"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1

content.text: Last observation — use it for final confirmation at max separation.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --slot 30 --why "Final budget point at 4-sigma separation to push candidate 4 support past theta before finalizing"

content.text: Candidate 4 (P=18.56d) resolved at support 1.0, well above theta. Finalize.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1 --why "After early lead by candidate 0 was overturned and a close 3 vs 4 alias battle, final points drive candidate 4 (18.56d) to support 1.0, clearing theta"

content.text:
Campaign complete for case-110 (run: `runs/dev-v1-case-110-r1`).

**Outcome: resolved** — candidate index 4, P ≈ 18.56 d, final support 0.99998 (θ = 0.997), all 6 observations used.

Path summary: candidate 0 (P=1.52d) initially led at 0.52 support and climbed to 0.95 after two confirming points at slots 4 and 8 — but a point at slot 10 sharply contradicted it, collapsing its support to 0 and elevating candidates 3 (P=1.06d) and 4 (P=18.56d) instead. That pair then flip-flopped over the next two points before the final observation at slot 30 drove candidate 4 to full support, clearing the resolution threshold with no budget to spare.
